notes.title: We improve tip picture !
notes.content: Hello everyone! Some play's feedback: "I saw the tip picture, but I still stuck ! " Here we say sorry!  Well, we now improve the tip picture. We want to say "don't give up, later levels are more fun".  Thank you for your feedback and support! We will continue to improve the game. : Steamhappy:

notes.title: Discount for Chinese New Year :D
notes.content:
For Chinese New Year!  We plan to carry out a week-long  30% discount! 
Promotion time is about January 24, 2017, Beijing time (January 23, 2017 US Pacific time at 10:00 am).

January 12, 2017 We won the first IMGA China "Best Indie Game Award" in Shenzhen. This greatly encouraged us, as we continue to develop new games added power, here again to thank you for encouragement and support!

IMGA official website:
Http://www.imgawards.com/news/announcing-winners-1st-imga-china/

IMGA China
Http://mp.weixin.qq.com/s/A2FwCNBr-b1MXLihPSDvqA

The new year we will open a new puzzle game project, I hope you continue to support us! I would like to wish everyone a happy and happy new year!ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Big update : Add “Trading Cards” & “Cloud Saves” !
notes.content:
Hello everyone:
        According to our proposal we have carried out this major update, as follows:
        1. Added a "Trading Cards”.
        2. Added “Cloud Saves”.
        3. Modified the game display dislocation problem, optimize in-game hints.
        4. Frame number lock 60.

      Thank you very much ! ^_^
